name: Plant function judgement
description: Scores whether the chosen job of a named plant part is the work that part does.

levels.label: Wrong job
levels.exemplar: The student says a leaf takes up water.

levels.label: Right job
levels.exemplar: The student says a leaf makes food for the plant.

name: Fraction equivalence judgement
description: Scores whether the chosen fraction names the same amount as the stem.

levels.label: Different amount
levels.exemplar: The student picks 2/3 for a stem of 2/4.

levels.label: Same amount
levels.exemplar: The student picks 1/2 for a stem of 2/4.
